title: observability-weekly-2026-07-27
content:
Observability team weekly notes — week ending 2026-07-27

Attendees: Aisha, Tom, Lena, Marcus, + SRE rotation (Priya)
Standup highlights / quick wins:
- Updated model-latency-by-route dashboard: added p99 and scaled-panel for long-tail (thanks Tom for the PR).
- Deployed sampling fix for trace-forwarder (reduces noisy spans from external auth) — preliminary sampling rate drop from 12k -> 7k spans/min.
- Cost telemetry: shipped new cost-per-token panel and cost attribution by model family (alpha).

Incidents / on-call notes:
- 2026-07-22 03:40 UTC: increased 95th% latency on hosted-api for several customers using long-context jobs. Pager fired.
  - Symptoms: p95 token latency rose from 220ms -> 520ms for seq_len>2048 requests. Error rate stable.
  - Triage notes: traces showed sustained KV cache evictions + retry storms from an upstream retry loop (customer-side). High mem pressure on worker pool triggered GC cycles in runtime.
  - Mitigation: temporarily increased worker mem limit and enabled emergency prefix-caching policy for affected models.
  - Follow-up: root-cause PR (infra#1823) to improve KV cache eviction policy and add backpressure on request admission. Ownership: Tom (lead), Marcus (follow-up perf test).

Tracing / distributed tracing work:
- Span naming standardization: agreed on span.name conventions for compilation/exec phases to make traces comparable across architectures. Confluence doc: CONFLUENCE-OBS-1234.
- Span explosion reduction: implemented batching of small internal spans in trace-forwarder; expect ~25% reduction in trace storage by next billing cycle.
- Sampling policy: added model-family level sampling overrides so top-volume customers can be sampled at higher rate without blowing quota. Need SLO review before broad rollout.

Dashboards / visualizations:
- Latency dashboards: added "latency by model version" dropdown and per-route heatmap.
- Cost dashboards: new panels for cost-per-token, cost-per-request, and estimated monthly spend by model family (alpha). Data sourced from cost-telemetry pipeline (ETL job obs.cost-agg-v2).
- Alerting: created a new alert "trace-storage-excess" when retained spans > 1.2x baseline for 24h. Alert flapping observed in staging — Lena to tune thresholds.

Cost telemetry / economics:
- Weekly snapshot: estimated inference cost (hosted) increased ~12% week-over-week driven by more long-context sessions and increase in p99 latency causing more tokens processed per request.
- Top contributors: Model-X long-context runs (~44% of delta), customer retry storms (~18%), increased sampling/trace volume (~10%).
- Quick wins: enable prefix caching for top-5 heavy customers (Aisha to coordinate with CS), reduce default trace retention for low-volume customers from 30d -> 14d (needs policy approval), and enable dynamic batching suggestions in Redwood Optimize for Model-X workloads.

Action items / owners:
- Tom: land KV-cache eviction policy change + add admission backpressure tests (PR infra#1823) — due 2026-08-03.
- Marcus: run perf regression tests for Model-X with varied cache sizes and quantization flags; share bench results — due 2026-08-05.
- Lena: tune "trace-storage-excess" alert thresholds in staging and follow up with SRE — due 2026-07-30.
- Aisha: coordinate prefix-caching rollout for top-5 customers with CS and product; prepare comms + rollback plan — due 2026-07-31.
- Priya (SRE rotation): add extra runbook bullets for long-context page (include GC mitigation knobs) — due 2026-07-29.

Open questions / blockers:
- Need sign-off from Security on reducing default trace retention for low-volume customers — security review ticket created (JIRA-OBS-567).
- Cost attribution accuracy: current cost-per-token uses model family heuristics; we need per-customer micro-billing to be confident before recommending price changes. Should we scope an engineering spike? (proposal in Confluence).

Meetings / syncs next week:
- Deep-dive: tracing sampling & retention (Thu 09:30 PT) — agenda: sampling policy, retention tiers, SLO impact.
- Dashboard review w/ CS (Wed 11:00 PT) — walk through cost panels and suggestions for customer-facing views.

Notes to self / informal:
- Quick reminder: follow up with infra on node upgrade schedule — older nodes show slightly higher GC rates for host runtime.
- Save example traces for Model-X long-context (sample ids attached in Slack thread).

EOF
